import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial import Delaunay
def _sig(a):
    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=float)
    if a.ndim != 2 or a.shape[0] != a.shape[1]:
        return -1.0
    k = np.arange(a.size, dtype=float)
    return float(np.sum(np.abs(a)) + np.sum(a.ravel() * np.cos(0.7 * k)))
P = np.array([[0.0, 0.0], [10.2, 1.3], [4.9, 8.8], [15.7, 9.6], [-3.1, 11.4],
              [8.3, 17.9], [19.4, -2.2], [2.6, 4.1]])
assert np.allclose(_sig(build_delaunay_neighbourhoods(P)), target)

import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial import Delaunay
def _sig(a):
    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=float)

t = np.linspace(0.0, 2.0 * np.pi, 11)[:-1] + 0.05 * np.sin(np.arange(10))
rad = 20.0 + 1.5 * np.cos(3.0 * np.arange(10))
P = np.vstack([np.column_stack([rad * np.cos(t), rad * np.sin(t)]),
               [[1.3, -0.7], [-6.2, 4.4]]])
w = np.arange(1.0, 13.0)
assert np.allclose(float(np.sum(build_delaunay_neighbourhoods(P).sum(axis=1) * w)), target)
